use_cases: Creating eye-catching hero section headers with animated neon glow effects
Adding retro-futuristic RGB text animations to landing pages
Enhancing promotional banners with color-distorted glowing typography
Building visually striking text for gaming or entertainment platforms
Implementing animated logo text effects for brand showcases
ai_summary: A WebGL-powered neon RGB text effect component that renders animated glowing text with RGB color distortion using custom vertex and fragment shaders. Creates a retro-futuristic aesthetic with vibrant color channels shifting and glowing. Ideal for hero sections, promotional banners, and anywhere eye-catching animated typography is needed.
